camel_example: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster CreateControlPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key k1 --Description ExampleControlPolicy --PolicyName ExampleControlPolicy --Tag.1.Value v1 --PolicyDocument '{"Version":"1","Statement":[{"Effect":"Deny","Action":["ram:UpdateRole","ram:DeleteRole","ram:AttachPolicyToRole","ram:DetachPolicyFromRole"],"Resource":"acs:ram:*:*:role/ResourceDirectoryAccountAccessRole"}]}' --ControlPolicyType RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY --EffectScope RAM --method POST --force
description_en: Use `CreateControlPolicy` to create a custom control policy
description_zh: 调用CreateControlPolicy创建自定义管控策略
kebab_example: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster create-control-policy --policy-name ExampleControlPolicy --description ExampleControlPolicy --effect-scope RAM --policy-document '{"Version":"1","Statement":[{"Effect":"Deny","Action":["ram:UpdateRole","ram:DeleteRole","ram:AttachPolicyToRole","ram:DetachPolicyFromRole"],"Resource":"acs:ram:*:*:role/ResourceDirectoryAccountAccessRole"}]}' --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --control-policy-type RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateControlPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The name of the control policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
管控策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the control policy.

The description must be 1 to 1,024 characters in length. It must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
管控策略描述。

长度为1~1024个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The effective scope of the control policy.

Valid value: RAM. This indicates that the control policy applies only to RAM users or RAM roles
parameters.help_zh:
管控策略的生效范围。

取值：RAM，表示该管控策略仅针对RAM用户或RAM角色生效
parameters.name: effect_scope

parameters.help_en:
The policy document.

The policy document can be up to 4,096 characters in length.

For more information about the policy language, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179096.html.

For examples, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181474.html
parameters.help_zh:
管控策略内容。

最大长度为4096个字符。

管控策略语言，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179096.html。

管控策略示例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181474.html
parameters.name: policy_document
